variants.body: The grass is still wet this morning: long tail held in a V, yellow eyes scanning for breakfast. Very serious walk.

variants.title: The grackles are shining on the grass
variants.body: Black at first glance, then purple, blue and bronze when the light hits them right now.

variants.title: A grackle is strutting near {green}
variants.body: Shiny and serious, tail in a V, marching across the grass looking for bugs.

variants.title: A grackle is singing like a rusty gate
variants.body: Puffed up in the early light, fluffing out, making a sound like squeaky hinges. He thinks it's beautiful.

variants.title: Squeak, creak, that's a grackle
variants.body: The rusty-gate song, first thing this morning, is how male grackles show off.

variants.title: A grackle is squeaking from a tree over {street}
variants.body: Puffed up, tail spread, singing his rusty-gate song with total confidence.

variants.title: Huge flocks of grackles are heading to roost
variants.body: Thousands, mixed with starlings and red-wings, streaming across the evening sky.

variants.title: A river of blackbirds overhead
variants.body: As the light goes, the fall flocks of grackles are enormous and very noisy.

variants.title: Grackles are streaming over {green}
variants.body: A long noisy river of blackbirds in the dusk, all heading to the same roost.

variants.title: A catbird just meowed at you
variants.body: Not a kitten. A slim gray bird hiding in the bush this morning, making a perfect cat sound.

variants.title: Mew, says the bushes
variants.body: That's a catbird. A meow, then a long rambling song, in the middle of the day.

variants.title: A catbird is meowing from the shrubs near {green}
variants.body: Somewhere in there is a slim gray bird with a black cap, sounding exactly like a cat.

variants.title: A catbird is gobbling berries
variants.body: Fueling up for the trip south right now. Every berry counts.

variants.title: Catbird snack time
variants.body: Hopping through the branches in the middle of the day, picking the ripest berries one by one.

variants.title: A catbird is eating berries near {green}
variants.body: Getting ready for a long trip south, one ripe berry at a time.

variants.title: A catbird is rambling on and on
variants.body: Squeaks, whistles, chatters, borrowed sounds, all jumbled together as the evening settles in.

variants.title: Catbird open mic night
variants.body: A long improvised song from deep inside the bushes as the light goes.

variants.title: A catbird is singing in the bushes along {street}
variants.body: A long, jumbly, improvised song, right as it gets dark.

variants.title: A song sparrow is singing the first song of the day
variants.body: Three clear notes, then a jumble, from the top of a shrub in the early light.

variants.title: Song sparrow on the top of a shrub
variants.body: Head back, beak open, singing the neighborhood's local tune in the middle of the day.

variants.title: A song sparrow is singing by {water}
variants.body: Perched on a low shrub, singing the song all the neighbors know.

variants.title: A song sparrow is pumping their tail
variants.body: Flitting a short way across the lawn right now, tail pumping up and down. That's how you know it's them.

variants.title: A streaky sparrow with a dark spot
variants.body: That spot in the middle of the chest is the song sparrow's badge, hopping by in the middle of the day.

variants.title: A song sparrow is hopping along the edge of {green}
variants.body: Streaky brown, dark chest spot, tail pumping as they flit from weed to weed.

variants.title: A song sparrow is tucking into the tangles
variants.body: As the light goes, low in a thick shrub, safe and snug for the night.

variants.title: Lights out for the song sparrow
variants.body: Deep in the brambles tonight, feathers fluffed, done singing for today.

variants.title: A song sparrow is sleeping near {water}
variants.body: Low in a tangled shrub, tucked away until morning.

variants.title: A kestrel is hovering in midair
variants.body: Wings fluttering, tail spread, head perfectly still in the middle of the day. Any second now, down onto a grasshopper.

variants.title: A tiny falcon is hanging in the sky
variants.body: Right now a kestrel is hovering in place like a helicopter, watching the grass.

variants.title: A kestrel is hovering over {green}
variants.body: Wings a blur, head perfectly still, staring down at the grass.

variants.title: A kestrel is perched on a wire
variants.body: Small and colorful, bobbing their tail in the middle of the day, eyes on the ground below.

variants.title: The smallest falcon is watching the street
variants.body: A kestrel on a wire, as colorful as a parrot and as focused as a hawk.

variants.title: A kestrel is watching from a wire along {street}
variants.body: Tail bobbing in the evening light, waiting for one last thing to move in the grass.

variants.title: Kestrels are nesting in an old building
variants.body: A nook in a cornice, right in the middle of the city, and a falcon slipping in and out of it today.

variants.title: A kestrel is bringing home a grasshopper
variants.body: Somewhere in a gap in the building, hungry chicks are waiting right now.

variants.title: Kestrels are nesting in a nook near {landmark}
variants.body: A gap in old brickwork makes a perfect falcon home, and the parents are busy all day.

variants.title: A Cooper's hawk just zipped through the trees
variants.body: Fast, low, and gone in the early light. Every small bird nearby froze.

variants.title: All the little birds just went quiet
variants.body: There's probably a Cooper's hawk perched in a tree nearby right now, very still.

variants.title: A Cooper's hawk is darting through the trees near {green}
variants.body: A flash of striped tail between the branches, and every small bird hides.

variants.title: A Cooper's hawk is sitting very still in a tree
variants.body: Red eyes, barred orange chest, long striped tail. Patient and focused, in the middle of the day.

variants.title: A hawk is hiding in plain sight
variants.body: Perched inside the tree, not on top, right now, so nobody sees them coming.

variants.title: A Cooper's hawk is perched in the trees near {green}
variants.body: Tucked inside the branches, watching everything below.

variants.title: A Cooper's hawk family is up in the tree
variants.body: Fluffy white chicks peeking over the edge of a stick nest today, waiting for the next meal.

variants.title: Hawk parents on duty
variants.body: Right now one is guarding the nest while the other hunts.

variants.title: Cooper's hawks are nesting in a tall tree near {green}
variants.body: High up, a stick nest, and fluffy white chicks waiting for a parent to come back.

variants.title: A peregrine is diving at top speed
variants.body: Out hunting in the early light: wings tucked, over 200 miles an hour. The fastest animal on Earth, right overhead.

variants.title: A falcon just stooped past
variants.body: That blur was a peregrine diving after a pigeon. The pigeon usually wins, honestly.

variants.title: A peregrine is diving over {street}
variants.body: From high above, wings folded, faster than anything else alive.

variants.title: A peregrine is perched on a high ledge
variants.body: Dark helmet, sharp eyes, scanning the sky from the city's cliffs in the middle of the day.

variants.title: The falcons are home on the bridge
variants.body: Side by side on a high beam right now. Bridges and skyscrapers are perfect cliffs for peregrines.

variants.title: A peregrine is perched high above {street}
variants.body: On a tall ledge in the evening light, dark helmet, watching the whole neighborhood.

variants.title: Peregrine chicks are on a skyscraper ledge
variants.body: Fluffy white balls of down, high above the street, waiting for their next meal right now.

variants.title: Young peregrines are learning to fly
variants.body: Clumsy first flights between rooftops today, with the parents watching closely.

variants.title: Peregrines are raising chicks high above {street}
variants.body: On a bare stone ledge, fluffy white chicks waiting for their parents to come back.

variants.title: A downy woodpecker is tapping for bugs

variants.title: A rabbit is dozing in the shade
variants.body: Eyes half closed, nose still twitching, safe under the bushes until the evening.

variants.title: A rabbit is out on the lawn at dusk
variants.body: As the light goes, a cottontail hops out from the bushes and starts nibbling, one ear always turning.

variants.title: A cottontail just zigzagged away
variants.body: A dog came by in the evening light, and the rabbit bolted, zigzagging, white tail flashing.

variants.title: A rabbit is snacking near {green}
variants.body: The lawn is quiet now and the clover is all theirs.

variants.title: A rabbit is nibbling in the dark
variants.body: Out on the grass tonight, close to the bushes, munching and listening.

variants.title: A cottontail is on the lawn tonight
variants.body: A small round shape near {green}, perfectly still, then a hop, then munching again.

variants.title: A rabbit is listening to the night
variants.body: Ears up, swiveling, nose working. All clear. Back to the clover.

variants.title: A rabbit mom is visiting her babies
variants.body: As the light goes, she slips over to a shallow nest in the grass, feeds the babies quickly, and leaves again.

variants.title: Baby rabbits are out on the lawn
variants.body: Tiny cottontails, barely bigger than a fist, nibbling clover in the early light.

variants.title: Little rabbits are exploring near {green}
variants.body: First light, and two young cottontails are hopping around the edge of the lawn, very brave, very small.

variants.title: Two rabbits are doing the leap dance
variants.body: One dashes at the other, who jumps straight up, high in the air. It's cottontail courtship, and it's happening right now on the lawn.

variants.title: The rabbits are chasing each other
variants.body: Round and round the lawn as the light goes, then a big jump. Spring romance, rabbit style.

variants.title: Two cottontails are leaping near {green}
variants.body: Dash, leap, land, repeat, in the evening light.

variants.title: A rabbit is nibbling twigs in the snow
variants.body: A cold morning, and a cottontail is chewing the tips of low bushes, fluffed up round.

variants.title: A rabbit is hiding under the snowy hedge
variants.body: Tucked under the bushes in the middle of the day, snow all around, cozy in a thick winter coat.

variants.title: Rabbit tracks are crossing the snow near {green}
variants.body: Two big back feet in front, two little front feet behind, from the hedge to the lawn and back.

variants.title: A turkey just flew down from the roost
variants.body: First light, a big flap from high in a tree, and a heavy landing on the lawn. Breakfast time.

variants.title: The turkeys are coming down for breakfast
variants.body: One by one in the early light, they're dropping out of the trees and gathering on the grass.

variants.title: Turkeys are gathering near {green}
variants.body: A little flock in the morning light, stretching their wings and starting to scratch for breakfast.

variants.title: A flock of turkeys is crossing the lawn
variants.body: Scratching, pecking, strolling, all together in the middle of the day. Nobody is in a hurry.

variants.title: A turkey is scratching for acorns
variants.body: Kick back with one big foot, peck, kick back with the other. They've found the good acorn spot.

variants.title: Turkeys are strolling near {green}
variants.body: A whole rafter of them, heads bobbing, wandering across the grass in the middle of the day.

variants.title: A turkey is flying up to roost
variants.body: As the light goes, a big flap and a scramble, and they're up in a tall tree for the night.

variants.title: The turkeys are going to bed in the trees
variants.body: One by one at dusk they're flapping up into the branches, settling in side by side.

variants.title: Turkeys are roosting near {green}
variants.body: Big dark shapes high in the trees as it gets dark, shuffling along the branches.

variants.title: The turkeys are asleep in the trees
variants.body: High up on the big branches tonight, safe from anything on the ground.

variants.title: A turkey is sleeping in a tall tree
variants.body: Head tucked, feathers fluffed, perched way above the lawn until morning.

variants.title: Turkeys are roosting in the trees near {green}
variants.body: A row of big round shapes up in the dark branches, fast asleep.

variants.title: A turkey is gobbling at sunrise
variants.body: Gobble-obble-obble! A male on the lawn, tail fanned, telling the whole neighborhood he's here.

variants.title: A turkey is strutting with his tail fanned
variants.body: Feathers fanned out, wings dragging, tail spread like a big fan, turning slowly so the hens can see.

variants.title: A turkey is showing off near {green}
variants.body: Tail up, head bright red and blue, gobbling at anything that moves. Even a car.

variants.title: A turkey hen is leading her poults
variants.body: Fluffy babies trailing behind her through the tall grass, peeping, catching bugs.

variants.title: Turkey babies are chasing bugs
variants.body: Little poults darting after grasshoppers while mom keeps watch.

variants.title: A turkey family is out near {green}
variants.body: Mom and a line of poults crossing the lawn in the evening light, heading for the trees.

variants.title: The turkeys are crossing the street
variants.body: A whole flock, strolling across one at a time while the cars wait. They take their time.

variants.title: A turkey is checking out the yard
variants.body: Pecking along the front walk in the middle of the day, then up onto the porch steps for a look around.

variants.title: Turkeys are walking down {street}
variants.body: A big flock taking a stroll down the sidewalk, completely unbothered.

variants.title: The turkeys are scratching through the snow
variants.body: Kicking the snow aside with big feet, looking for acorns underneath.

variants.title: Turkey tracks are crossing the snow
variants.body: Big three-toed prints across the lawn this morning, a whole flock's worth.

variants.title: Turkeys are puffed up in the cold near {green}
variants.body: Feathers fluffed out, standing together in the snow, looking twice their size.
